info.title: ModelShared (Service)
info.description: Data model containing model dependencies of the clients of the current microservice (WebApp, ServiceTest)

get.summary: Returns the loaded EGM84-30 geoid-model information for service discovery.
get.description: This is the microservice entry endpoint. It returns the same model identity and provenance as the ModelInfo endpoint.

post.summary: Synchronously converts EGM84 mean-sea-level depths to WGS84 ellipsoidal depths.
post.description: This operation is stateless. Latitude and longitude are WGS84 radians. Input and output depths are SI metres, positive downward from their explicitly named reference surfaces. The complete request is rejected if any position is invalid.

post.summary: Synchronously converts WGS84 ellipsoidal depths to EGM84 mean-sea-level depths.
post.description: This inverse operation is stateless. Latitude and longitude are WGS84 radians. Input and output depths are SI metres, positive downward from their explicitly named reference surfaces. The complete request is rejected if any position is invalid.

get.summary: Returns the loaded EGM84-30 geoid model identity, resolution, interpolation accuracy, runtime version, and coefficient hash.
Returns cumulative usage counters retained across service restarts. This operation is intentionally not exposed as an MCP tool.

ReferencePoint.description: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and ellipsoidal depth. Geographic angles use SI radians; linear coordinates and ellipsoidal depth use SI metres. X/Y are Riemannian north/east arc coordinates, not projected easting/northing. Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

GroundMudLineDepth.description: Ellipsoidal depth of the ground surface or mud line at the cluster site, with the actual surface identified by site context. GaussianValue.Mean is the expected value in SI metres (m), referenced to the WGS84 ellipsoid. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
A null standard deviation means unspecified, not zero.
Bounds do not imply a confidence interval or truncated-normal model without an explicit provider definition.

requiredContext: surface identity: ground or mud line
surface identity: ground or mud line
surface identity: ground or mud line

TopWaterDepth.description: Ellipsoidal depth of the upper water surface at a site; distinct from water-column thickness and the depth of the seabed. GaussianValue.Mean is the expected value in SI metres (m), referenced to the WGS84 ellipsoid. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
A null standard deviation means unspecified, not zero.
Bounds do not imply a confidence interval or truncated-normal model without an explicit provider definition.
A single-well flag does not change the resource into a Well entity.
